#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: word frequency + palindrome checker -> text analyzer."""
import re
from collections import Counter

def analyze(text):
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", text.lower())
    freq = Counter(words)
    pals = sorted({w for w in words if w == w[::-1] and len(w) > 1})
    return freq, pals

if __name__ == "__main__":
    text = "Anna saw a racecar. Anna loves level radar stats."
    freq, pals = analyze(text)
    print("top:", freq.most_common(3))
    print("palindromes:", pals)
    assert freq["anna"] == 2
    assert pals == ["anna", "level", "racecar", "radar", "stats"]
    print("OK: frequencies and palindrome detection combined")

title: Random Maze Sampler
description: PROGRAM: Random Maze Sampler (['maze generator', 'dice statistics']). Uses dice rolls to pick maze seeds, then generates and validates each maze. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: dice stats + maze generator -> random maze sampler."""
import random

def gen_maze(w, h, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    maze = [[1]*(2*w+1) for _ in range(2*h+1)]
    stack, seen = [(0,0)], {(0,0)}
    maze[1][1] = 0
    while stack:
        cx, cy = stack[-1]
        nbs = [(cx+dx, cy+dy, dx, dy) for dx, dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
               if 0 <= cx+dx < w and 0 <= cy+dy < h and (cx+dx, cy+dy) not in seen]
        if nbs:
            nx, ny, dx, dy = rng.choice(nbs)
            maze[2*cy+1+dy][2*cx+1+dx] = 0
            maze[2*ny+1][2*nx+1] = 0
            seen.add((nx, ny)); stack.append((nx, ny))
        else: stack.pop()
    return maze

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(31)
    seeds = [rng.randint(1, 6) + rng.randint(1, 6) for _ in range(3)]  # 2d6 seeds
    print("dice-picked seeds:", seeds)
    for s in seeds:
        m = gen_maze(5, 5, seed=s)
        open_cells = sum(1 for row in m for c in row if c == 0)
        assert open_cells == 2*5*5 - 1
    print("OK: 3 dice-seeded mazes, all perfect")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: todo list + json formatter -> pretty persistent todos."""
import json, os, tempfile

class Todo:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.path = path
        self.items = json.load(open(path)) if os.path.exists(path) else []
    def add(self, t): self.items.append({"task": t, "done": False})
    def done(self, i): self.items[i]["done"] = True
    def save(self):
        with open(self.path, "w") as f:
            json.dump(self.items, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    path = tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".json")
    t = Todo(path); t.add("Ship lane O12"); t.add("Verify demos"); t.done(0); t.save()
    raw = open(path).read()
    print(raw)
    assert '"done": true' in raw and raw.index("\n") > 0  # pretty-printed
    assert json.loads(raw)[0]["task"] == "Ship lane O12"
    os.unlink(path)
    print("OK: todos stored as pretty JSON")

demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: stopwatch + sorting -> benchmark lab."""
import random, time

def bubble(a):
    a = a[:]
    for i in range(len(a)):
        for j in range(len(a)-1-i):
            if a[j] > a[j+1]: a[j], a[j+1] = a[j+1], a[j]
    return a

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(8)
    data = [rng.randint(0, 999) for _ in range(800)]
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); b = bubble(data); t1 = time.perf_counter()
    t2 = time.perf_counter(); s = sorted(data); t3 = time.perf_counter()
    print("bubble: %.4fs  builtin: %.6fs" % (t1-t0, t3-t2))
    assert b == s
    assert (t1-t0) > (t3-t2)
    print("OK: both sort correctly; builtin is faster as expected")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: markdown parser + word frequency -> markdown word stats."""
import re
from collections import Counter

def md_to_text(md):
    t = re.sub(r"^#+\s*", "", md, flags=re.M)
    t = re.sub(r"\*\*(.+?)\*\*", r"\1", t)
    t = re.sub(r"\[(.+?)\]\(.+?\)", r"\1", t)
    t = re.sub(r"[`>#\-]", "", t)
    return t

if __name__ == "__main__":
    doc = "# Archive Report\n\nThe **archive** grows. The archive teaches.\n\n- data in\n- data out"
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", md_to_text(doc).lower())
    freq = Counter(w for w in words if w not in {"the"})
    print(freq.most_common(4))
    assert freq["archive"] == 3 and freq["data"] == 2
    print("OK: markdown stripped, word stats correct")

title: Fibonacci Dice Lab
description: PROGRAM: Fibonacci Dice Lab (['dice statistics', 'fibonacci']). Rolls dice to pick Fibonacci indices, then verifies the Fibonacci identities on the picks. This record IS the complete runnable program — copy it to a file and run with python3.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: dice + fibonacci -> fibonacci dice lab."""
import random

def fib(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n): a, b = b, a+b
    return a

if __name__ == "__main__":
    rng = random.Random(17)
    picks = sorted(rng.randint(5, 20) for _ in range(4))
    print("dice-picked indices:", picks)
    for n in picks:
        # Cassini-adjacent identity: fib(n)^2 + fib(n+1)^2 = fib(2n+1)
        assert fib(n)**2 + fib(n+1)**2 == fib(2*n+1), n
        print("fib(%d)=%d  identity holds" % (n, fib(n)))
    print("OK: Fibonacci sum-of-squares identity on dice picks")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: http server + url parser -> request logger."""
import threading, urllib.request
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs

LOG = []
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        p = urlparse(self.path)
        LOG.append({"path": p.path, "query": parse_qs(p.query)})
        body = b"logged"
        self.send_response(200); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, *a): pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    srv = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
    port = srv.server_address[1]
    threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    for path in ("/search?q=jahn&page=2", "/about"):
        urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%d%s" % (port, path), timeout=10).read()
    srv.shutdown(); srv.server_close()
    print(LOG)
    assert LOG[0] == {"path": "/search", "query": {"q": ["jahn"], "page": ["2"]}}
    assert LOG[1]["path"] == "/about"
    print("OK: server parsed and logged 2 request URLs")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mix: csv->json + word frequency -> CSV text analyzer."""
import csv, io, re
from collections import Counter

REVIEWS = "product,review\nwidget,\"great widget, works great\"\ngadget,\"great gadget, great value\"\n"

def analyze(csv_text, column):
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(csv_text)))
    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+", " ".join(r[column] for r in rows).lower())
    return Counter(words).most_common(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    top = analyze(REVIEWS, "review")
    print(top)
    assert top[0] == ("great", 4)
    print("OK: CSV reviews analyzed, top word 'great' x4")
